title: Handover
description: Change of responsibility or ownership. Corresponds to the EPCIS TransactionEvent. The handover is the place where a chain usually breaks - which is why it is an event of its own and not a side field of transport.

type.description: Kind of document: purchase order, despatch advice, invoice, bill of lading, other.

items.description: The units handed over, if they are more than the subject of the entry.
